newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA CAPITAL MARKET ON THE SLIDE - BROKER.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA CAPITAL MARKET ON THE SLIDE - BROKER.

text.p: Bearish sentiment took hold of the Romanian capital market last week, sending volumes and turnover down after a strong rally the week before, a Bucharest brokerage house said on Monday.
The fall on both the stock exchange and the over-the-counter (OTC) market was triggered by supply far outstripping demand, VANGUARD securities said in a statement.
The VAB index for the stock exchange dropped by 10 percent on the week to 880.3 points on Friday. The VAB-RASDAQ, the index for OTC trading, slipped 5.7 percent to 3,551.12 points.
The bearish mood was expected to plague the market throughout this week, brokers said.

Weekly turnover levels were also on the slide, with the bourse registering 37 billion lei, down from 41 billion the previous week. The RASDAQ system recorded 43 billion lei, 16 billion less than a week before.

The Bucharest bourse trades 36 stocks, four on the first tier. Vanguard said stock exchange capitalisation was 2.4 trillion lei, with the first-tier Azomures fertiliser maker accounting for 25.5 percent of that capitalisation level.
Another 24.9 percent goes to high-cap Otchim chemical plant. Pharmaceutical companies Antibiotice and Terapia, the other two first-tier stocks, have 12.7 and 10 percent respectively.
The RASDAQ has a total capitalisation of 10.1 trillion lei, with Sidex steel mill the highest capitalisation company with 15 percent of the market level.
The OTC market lists more than 2,700 companies. It trades an average 480 stocks per session.
